keyEndpoints.purpose: Sport catalogue, but only 214 bytes and no football events attached. Recorded because it is the only /sports endpoint this brand serves.
178 KB of EGT Digital CASINO tournament/jackpot content — prize pools and dates, not match odds. NOT an odds source.

finding: Casino-first. app.bilion.ro/api/v1/sports answers 200 with a 214-byte catalogue and /api/v1/tournaments returns 178 KB of EGT Digital CASINO tournament content (jackpots and prize pools). The event paths a sportsbook would use — /api/v1/events, /api/v1/matches, /api/v1/odds — are all HTTP 404. There is no prematch football feed to read.
